description: Visual review of the tracking (Claude, 2026-10-07), made from validation/game-puck-spotcheck.jpg and validation/game-possession-review.jpg (scripts/game-review.py, fixed seeds). Judged by eye at the sheets' resolution (the puck is about 10-20 px); 'plausible' means the circle sits on a dark disk-shaped object where a puck can be, but the sheet does not show enough to be sure.

not_seen_puck_visible_frames: 212.12 s (puck at the far board by the right goal; tracked 0.36 s later)
12.60 s (probably: a dark dot left of the centre circle)
puck_spotcheck.note: Most 'not seen' frames show no clear puck at this resolution: hidden under or behind figures, motion-blurred, or during the camera move at 21 s.

possession_review.settings: max gap 7 s, minimum episode 0.5 s (user, 2026-10-07); the 24 episodes are a new random draw (seed 5) from the recounted episodes
possession_review.probably_wrong_detail: Episodes 4 (E-LW, match 31.7-32.7 s) and 15 (E-LW, 180.3-180.9 s): the circle sits on the dark edge of the near board, in the strip of ice the housing hides; most likely a false detection there.
possession_review.previous_review: With the previous settings (max gap 10 s, minimum episode 0.2 s) another random draw gave 17 consistent of 18 checkable, 1 wrong (the opening face-off) and 6 not seen.

false_detection_hotspots_checked.what: dark rim of the green ice logo next to the left goal
false_detection_hotspots_checked.after_fix: 88 -> 34 tracked frames (candidate-density feature and batch-2 labels)
no longer among the busiest places

false_detection_hotspots_checked.what: real puck resting near the far blue line (127, 208, 287 s)
real puck resting on a slot near the left circle (260-262 s)
real puck in the far corner by the right goal (several times)

passes_review.sheet: 16 random hand-overs, each shown at release and receipt with the arrow drawn on the stabilised frame (scratch sheet, not committed)
passes_review.result: The arrows follow the slots and the puck positions where the puck is visible, but at 360p the release and the reception can rarely be confirmed frame by frame; the passes are not individually verified.
flagged: Match 232.6 s, W-C -> W-RD: a hand is over the right goal in the release frame (video 239.3-240.4 s hand episode); probably a stoppage, possibly a goal, not a pass.
Two hand-overs of 46-59 mm at area borders looked like scrambles; this led to the 80 mm 'battle' rule (6 such events).
